| Quarter | Net income | Basis |
|---|---|---|

| Q2 2025 | ≈ $2.91B | Recalled from reported results |

| Q4 2025 | ≈ –$1.65B (net loss) | Inferred, see below |
| **Full year** | **≈ $7.77B** | Sum of the four quarters |

The Q4 figure is derived, not taken from the filing. I recall full-year reported diluted EPS of about $1.36, while the first three quarters sum to about $1.65. That implies Q4 EPS of about –$0.29, or a net loss near $1.65B. The loss is plausibly due to acquisition-related and impairment charges, but this should be checked against the 10-K.

Average quarterly net income ≈ $7.77B ÷ 4 ≈ **$1.94B**.
